UP Budaun ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026: Application Process and Guidelines Open for 11 Vacancies

Key takeawaysThe UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal has released an official notification for the recruitment of Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE) Educator posts in Budaun. The current recruitment drive aims to fill a total of 11 positions. Eligible and interested candidate

The UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal has released an official notification for the recruitment of Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE) Educator posts in Budaun. The current recruitment drive aims to fill a total of 11 positions. Eligible and interested candidates can submit their online applications through the designated portal.

Important Dates and Application Schedule

The online application process for the Budaun ECCE Educator posts commenced on October 21, 2026. Candidates must complete and submit their forms by the closing date of October 29, 2026. Applicants should note that there is no application fee required for any category of candidate.

Eligibility Criteria and Age Limits

To be eligible for the UP Budaun ECCE Educator positions, candidates must meet specific educational and age requirements:

  • Age Limit: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxations apply according to government regulations for the vacancy.
  • Educational Qualifications: Candidates must hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Home Science as the main subject with a minimum of 50% marks from a UGC-recognized university (with a 5% relaxation for reserved categories). Alternatively, candidates can possess a minimum two-year diploma in Teacher Nursery Training (NTT), CTT (Nursery), DPSE, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE).

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

Job seekers planning to apply should carefully review the official notification on the Sewayojan portal to verify exact educational equivalencies, category-wise breakdowns, and detailed age relaxation parameters before submission.

  • Confirmed Facts: The recruitment is for 11 ECCE Educator posts in Budaun via the UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal. The application window runs from October 21, 2026, to October 29, 2026, with zero application fees.
  • Unknowns/Unconfirmed Details: Specific selection round formats, exact merit calculation steps beyond basic educational criteria, and posting locations within the district are subject to official guidelines.
  • How to Check: Readers can verify all original details and access application links directly through the official Sewayojan website at https://sewayojan.up.nic.in/ or via the source reference at https://sarkariresult.com.cm/up-budaun-ecce-educator-2026/.
